title: From End to Overworld
description: Saves you from the End void, teleporting back to Overworld.
body:
# From the End to the Overworld (FEtO)

## About this datapack
This datapack teleports the player from the void in The End dimension to the Overworld at height 500 (keeping their horizontal X and Z coordinates), giving them a chance to survive.

The datapack also features custom advancements that complement the datapack itself (perfect for challenge lovers!)

### Note:
If you find any bugs, please report them in the **"#🪲report-bugs"** channel on our Discord server, using the tag "FEtO"!
